title: Public transport fares rise in E. Visayas amid higher fuel costs

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Commuters in Eastern Visayas will pay higher fares for public utility vehicles following the approval of a fare increase aimed at helping drivers and operators cope with rising fuel and operating costs. For traditional public utility jeepneys, the minimum fare has increased from P13 to P14 for the first four kilometers, with an additional P0.20 for every succeeding kilometer. For modern public utility jeepneys, the minimum fare is now P17 for the first four kilometers, up from P15, with an additional P0.20 for every succeeding kilometer.
